title: Declare project metadata and dependencies
body:
pyproject.toml currently only configures Ruff — there is no [project] table and no dependencies declared, even though SETUP.md instructs contributors to run `uv sync`.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [project] table with name, version and Python requirement
- Core dependencies declared and locked via uv
- `uv sync` works from a clean clone

title: Scaffold the Clean Architecture layout
body:
Create the empty package structure defined in docs/OVERVIEW.md and ADR-006: src/core/{domain,application,interfaces,services,events,models}, src/infrastructure, src/presentation. This is the skeleton every future feature (Discord adapter, Speech-to-Text adapter, AI provider, ...) will be built inside.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Packages exist with __init__.py placeholders
- A short README in src/ links back to docs/OVERVIEW.md
- No layer imports another layer in the wrong direction (Core has zero imports from infrastructure/presentation)

title: Add a pytest scaffold
body:
There is no tests/ directory yet. ADR-006 commits to high testability as a consequence of the Core/Adapter split — that only pays off if tests actually exist from the start.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- tests/ mirrors the src/ layout
- pytest configured and runnable via `uv run pytest`
- One trivial passing test as a template for future ones

title: Add a CI workflow for lint and tests
body:
There is no .github/workflows/ yet. Every push and pull request should run Ruff and the test suite automatically.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- GitHub Actions workflow runs `ruff check` and `pytest` on push/PR
- Workflow fails the build on lint or test errors
- Status badge added to README.md

title: Configure the VS Code workspace
body:
Add a shared VS Code workspace configuration so every contributor gets the same formatting and linting behavior out of the box.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- .vscode/settings.json enables format-on-save with Ruff
- .vscode/extensions.json recommends the Python and Ruff extensions
- Documented in SETUP.md
